summary: Eastern International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held June 22, 2026. Shareholders approved redesignation of 1,000,000 preferred shares as Series A preferred shares, leaving 49,000,000 preferred shares terms to be set later, and amended the memorandum and articles of association. No transaction price, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. This is a routine corporate housekeeping matter, not a special situation event.
